entries.title: Fixed Axial Crown Wheel and Weighted Crossbar Display
entries.description: One wholly newly authored static crown-wheel and weighted-crossbar teaching display. A grounded full bed and two-post upper bridge carry a vertical spindle with two complete splayed pallet plates and a complete horizontal top bar with two fixed end weights. An independent rear grounded standard carries a perpendicular horizontal shaft, open-spoke hub and one integral thick crown ring whose blunt teeth project axially from its rim rather than radially from a flat disk. Opposite-height pallet plates sit visibly clear of the wheel tips in this illustrative pose. Unlike the old parallel-shaft forked anchor with long pendulum and flat tooth disk, this whole organization has orthogonal axes, axial crown teeth and top horizontal weighted bar; unlike the governor it has no ball weights, diamond links or sliding sleeve. All coordinates and meshes new, three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, one model zero scenes. No escapement action, precise crown/pallet profile, engaged contact, oscillation, timekeeping, rate, winding, motion, gearing, torque, manufacture, operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction are not made.

entries.description: One wholly newly authored fixed pivoted-slot lever and guided-ram teaching display. entries.title: Fixed Perpendicular End Arms and Whole Skein Winding Tool
entries.description: One newly authored complete handheld cross-arm skein-winding tool appearance standing in a fixed display pose. A complete turned central hand column joins two complete transverse wooden end arms at right angles to one another. Both arms have integral shallow upturned retaining ends, with the lower full arm resting on its flat underside. Three whole closed thick yarn-appearance circuits alternately pass around the four separated arm ends, making a nonplanar long loop around the entire tool rather than a flat coil. This is not the earlier supported horizontal four-wing warping cage with its stands removed: there are no paired radial crosses, four parallel longitudinal rails, bearings or crank. entries.title: Fixed Closed Radial Cross Link and Headed Pin Ring
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed planar closed cross-link ring toy appearance, lying flat. Each upper link is separated from the lower layer and connected by full headed pins at both inner and outer cycle vertices and every crossing. The ring closure uses newly drawn nonparallel radial endpoints and off-centre crossing axes; it is not an old straight lattice gate bent or copied into a circle. Unlike the single rhombus inversor on two fixed posts, this is a complete repeated closed cycle without grounded origins, output arm, track or staves. entries.title: Fixed Open Offset Rafter and Central Aperture Roof Frame
entries.description: One complete original open timber roof framework: eight full grounded posts with stone feet support a continuous peripheral octagonal bearing ring; eight inclined tangentially offset chord rafters form a cyclic overlapping arrangement around a real central polygonal aperture, with no central post or independent crown ring. Each rafter crosses an adjacent rafter at a different position along its sloping length. The roof is deliberately uncovered so the entire rafter organisation remains visible; no cover, walls or weather enclosure are promised. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, complete horizontal bounds centred.
